Almena ID is a set of repositories, one per project, under
[github.com/almena-id](https://github.com/almena-id), checked out side by side
in one workspace. Each is built, tested and released on its own.

## What every change keeps

- **Each project's `AGENTS.md` is its law.** It says what the project is, how
  it is laid out and every rule its code follows. Read it before changing
  anything there, and keep it true in the same change.
- **Everything is written in English**: code, comments, documentation,
  commits. What people read in the interfaces is translated — English is the
  source, Spanish the first translation — never written into the code.
- **`task check` passes.** Every project runs its checks with
  [Task](https://taskfile.dev): `task --list` shows the rest.
- **The API decides.** A rule a portal checks for the person's sake — a
  required field, a length, what a state allows — is enforced again by the
  API, with a test, in the same change.
- **Text never leaves its box**, in any language, from a 320px phone up.

## Running it on your machine

The [`develop`](https://github.com/almena-id/develop) repository runs the whole
platform on one machine, behind one Caddy with a wildcard certificate, each
subdomain routed to its project. Its README walks through the hosts file, the
certificate and starting each project.
